response.sql: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM signals GROUP BY rfistat), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) AS overall_avg FROM signals), kept AS (SELECT sa.rfistat, sa.avg_modindex, b.overall_avg FROM status_averages AS sa CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE sa.avg_modindex > b.overall_avg) SELECT rfistat, avg_modindex, avg_modindex - overall_avg AS above_baseline, ABS(avg_modindex - (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) FROM kept)) AS difference_from_kept_mean FROM kept

assumptions.assumption: “How far it differs” means the absolute difference from the mean of the kept status averages.

alternatives.interpretation: If “differs” calls for a signed deviation, positive values indicate averages above the kept-status mean.
